profile_text.body:
Stack AI, at stack-ai.com, describes itself as a platform for enterprises to deploy AI agents at scale. The company says its drag-and-drop, no-code platform lets customers build secure and compliant AI applications in minutes, and that agents built on it can read, write, and execute tasks inside existing systems through more than 300 enterprise integrations. Stack AI also says it supports AI transformation and adoption across a range of industries and enterprises.

The company's product is described as a no-code AI app builder with enterprise deployment, workflow automation, and data connector governance. Customer statements quoted on the site describe using Stack AI to build AI assistants for students in a matter of weeks without coding, to test, deploy, and manage a range of agents in production, and to support governance, validation, and oversight in a regulated banking environment, where one quoted customer says the platform is serving as a catalyst in the bank's growth story. No litigation, MCP server, SEC filing, or patent facts are recorded for the company.
